messages:
deploybot: deploybot started canary deploy v3.8.2 -> gpu-pool-2. Change window scheduled 23:00 UTC. Eval gate: running prompt-eval suite 'summarizer' and 'customer_summary'.

alex: holding the rollout — prompt-eval showing regression on customer_summary set, QA delta +4.7% net quality vs baseline. see quick snapshot: https://redwood.internal/evals/3456 👀

priya: where's the failing prompt list? can we just pin prod back to v3.8.1 while we triage?

deploybot: note: v3.8.2 included tokenizer migration. automatic rollback not available for tokenizer changes. manual rollback will require compatibility check with stored KV cache and index versions.

mike: if rollback is risky, alternative: block full rollout, pin prod-route to v3.8.1, leave canary on v3.8.2 for bisect. how are perf/latency on canary?

priya: canary latencies are stable (p95 ~ 120ms). but quality regression is visible in summaries -> product impact.

alex: recommendation: hold full rollout, pin prod to v3.8.1, kick off tokenizer bisect for v3.8.2 change. need signoff from @tara (release-manager) + QA.

qa-bot: prompt-eval quick report:
- permalink: https://redwood.internal/evals/3456
- top regression: refund_summary prompt -> hallucination_rate +9.2%
- sample diff preview included in report.

tara: Tara (release-manager) here — can we get a short remediation plan in <30m? if yes i'll sign the hold and schedule a hotfix slot. otherwise we should plan a rollback.

priya: remediation plan (high level):
1) pin prod-route -> v3.8.1 (edge) now
2) start tokenizer-bisect (devs: @alex @mike) to isolate commit
3) prepare v3.8.3 patch reverting tokenizer change if bisect confirms
4) run targeted QA smoke on canary and smoke prompt-set
est time: ~90 minutes to reach verification

release-manager: i approve the hold. @deploybot please pin prod-route to v3.8.1 and add note 'holding due to eval gate regression'. 👍

deploybot: action taken: pinned prod-route -> v3.8.1; ticket created JIRA-4567; change window shifted to next slot 02:00 UTC. canaries remain on v3.8.2 for bisect. audit: user=deploybot, reason="eval-gate hold" :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks. i'll start the bisect now and report back with the offending commit range.

priya: prepping quick smoke prompt-set now. uploading to S3: `s3://redwood-evals/smoke/3456`

mike: note for ops: consider temporary fallback policy to route canary traffic to quantized-lite model if we see perf regressions during the bisect.

release-manager: good. document this in release notes and patch plan, and post to #incidents only if we need rollforward. closing this thread unless new blockers surface. :lock:
